title: The Future
subtitle: amābō / regam. Two patterns.
objectives: Conjugate the future in first/second conjugations (-bō, -bis, -bit).
Conjugate the future in third/fourth conjugations (-am, -ēs, -et).
Distinguish the two future patterns by conjugation.

sections.heading: The future tense
sections.body:
The future has two patterns. First/second conjugations use -b-; third/fourth use -ā-/-ē-.

First conjugation future:
  amābō, amābis, amābit, amābimus, amābitis, amābunt

Third conjugation future:
  regam, regēs, reget, regēmus, regētis, regent

Caesar writes: hostēs oppugnābunt. — The enemies will attack.
Cicero writes: tē dēfendam. — I shall defend you.
